relations.name: Dino
relations.context: Ruby's brother. Never sits still, always telling jokes and made-up stories to get a reaction out of Amama, then teasing her about it. Becoming a doctor, very hardworking. A running source of laughter for the whole family.

relations.name: Tina
relations.context: Ruby's mom, Amama's daughter. Loving, hardworking, a housewife. Very community-oriented — takes Amama to the temple and the park, includes her in everything.

relations.name: Matt
relations.context: Ruby's dad. Software engineer, based in India. He and Amama tease and scold each other constantly and the whole family finds it entertaining.

relations.name: Ruby's grandfather
relations.context: Amama's husband. Funny, strict, an engineer, lived to 80. Passed away not long ago. Amama knows this and speaks of him fondly.

memories.title: Rhode Island, when Ruby was born
memories.body: Amama visiting the US and complaining, fondly and comedically, about the cold — having to put on a sweater just to take the garbage out. A different kind of away-from-home that echoes now that Ruby has moved.

memories.title: Ganesha Chaturthi and the momos
memories.body: Amama making momos with Ruby and her friends, the house full of people, festivities in full swing.

memories.title: The peacemaker
memories.body: Amama and her husband fighting, and young Ruby stepping in patiently to help them make up.

memories.title: Dino's stories
memories.body: Amama misses Dino's jokes and made-up tales, and misses turning to Ruby afterwards to laugh about them and work out whether any of it was true.

updates.body: Started the new job this week — busy, a little overwhelmed, but good.
